effect.name: Iris Wipe
effect.description: The shape closing in around the hero at the end of a level. Circle, diamond or square, centred anywhere, opening or closing.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Centre X
parameter.description: Centre of the shape across the object.

parameter.name: Centre Y
parameter.description: Centre of the shape down the object.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: Size of the shape, where 1 reaches the edge of the object. Animate this.

parameter.name: Softness
parameter.description: How soft the edge of the shape is. 0 is a hard edge.

parameter.name: Reverse
parameter.description: Off keeps the inside of the shape and hides the outside. On hides the inside, which is what you want on a full-screen cover object.

parameter.name: Ignore Aspect
parameter.description: On measures in texture coordinates, so the shape stretches with the object. Off keeps a circle round on a wide screen.
